answer_position.meaning_preservation: Only answer-slot permutation is allowed; answer text and question text are unchanged.

explanation_uniqueness.production_policy: No copied boilerplate within a quiz; repeated explanations remain review signals unless explicitly justified.

answer_length_clues.implementation: CQ-C06 requires both the 1.8x character ratio and a two-word-count gap versus the longest distractor

cefr_category_coverage.required: Every production row has a canonical level and quiz category; unknown values are rejected by schema/QA.

explanation_quality.production_policy: Explicit subject/pronoun-specific explanations must match the question blank subject; generic rule explanations remain valid.
